message.content: {"note_claim": "The Falkland Islands have never been part of Argentina, although Argentina has tried to claim them as their own.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Britain reasserted its rule in 1833, but Argentina maintains its claim to the islands.", "reason": "The page confirms that Britain reasserted its rule (implying prior British sovereignty) and that Argentina maintains a claim to the islands, directly supporting the note's assertion that Argentina has tried to claim them without having sovereignty."}

parsed.note_claim: The Falkland Islands have never been part of Argentina, although Argentina has tried to claim them as their own.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Britain reasserted its rule in 1833, but Argentina maintains its claim to the islands.
parsed.reason: The page confirms that Britain reasserted its rule (implying prior British sovereignty) and that Argentina maintains a claim to the islands, directly supporting the note's assertion that Argentina has tried to claim them without having sovereignty.
